package main

type stringList []string

func (s *stringList) String() string { return "" }

func (s *stringList) Set(v string) error { return nil }

func (s *stringList) Unused() {}

type guard struct{}

func (g *guard) Lock() {}

func (g *guard) Unlock() {}

type walker struct{}

func (w walker) Visit(n int) int { return n }

func (w walker) Spare() {}

type clock struct{}

func (c clock) Deadline() int { return 0 }

func (c clock) Done() {}

func (c clock) Err() error { return nil }

func (c clock) Reset() {}

func (c clock) Idle() {}

func main() {
	var l stringList
	var g guard
	var w walker
	var c clock
	use(&l, &g, w, c)
}

func use(args ...any) {}
